label: The Hitmen

won.source: The fed’s own title histories page of 8 April 2003 names The Hitmen its Tag Team Champions; when and where they won the belts is not recorded.

note: The likeliest staging is the tag match Renegade and Nightmare won on the fed’s first Anarchy, 27 March 2003, but that show’s own results never call it a title match. Recorded at the precision the record supports.
